english.toefl: 5.0 for tests on or after January 21, 2026; 92 for earlier tests
english.note: Graduate School standards; qualifying English-language education can satisfy the requirement. Lower scores may be admitted for in-person programs with program approval and an arrival English assessment. Scores must be within two years of enrollment.

applicationFee.note: International applicants pay an additional $6 processing fee. MDTP explicitly cannot provide fee waivers to international applicants; domestic financial-hardship and qualifying pipeline applicants may inquire.

funding.note: The Guide offers funding to all program students through fellowships, traineeships and research assistantships, with continued support contingent on adequate academic/research progress.
